visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Map Instead of an Object Used as a Dictionary
visualizerParams.problemDescription: An object with hasOwnProperty checks counts the words, and its size is found with Object.keys. Use a Map. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: A Map has no inherited keys to guard against (an object would misbehave for a word like constructor), and size is a property instead of a computation.
